documented: GET /api/v1/key exposes per-key credit fields including limit_remaining and usage.
Paid requests may be rejected with 402 when the account in-flight spending budget is full.
429 can arise from OpenRouter platform protection or the upstream provider; successful responses do not include X-RateLimit headers.
OpenRouter recommends honoring Retry-After and exponential backoff.

account_specific_verification.scope: These are per-key credit limits/remaining values, not concurrency quotas.

limits_evidence.interpretation: Credit sufficiency is currently positive for all three keys, but no fixed OpenRouter account concurrency number is published or verified. A bounded load test may proceed only with a predeclared cap, immediate 429/402 abort, and no claim that 1/4/8/16/32 are account-safe.
